scope: Screen compiled decode threadgroup geometry while preserving FP32 arithmetic and SIMD reduction.
observed_existing_implementation: Four SIMD groups per threadgroup; four adjacent output columns per SIMD group; indexed active row variants. Input vectorization and per-channel reuse are already implemented.
candidate: Keep four columns per SIMD group and the exact lane-word/FMA order. Compare 2/4/8 SIMD groups per threadgroup, binding group output stride to group width; control is four.
required_before_timing: Compile from frozen headers in an isolated directory, never dirty root
All selected-row masks and row-padded/input-output guard parents exact to four-SIMD control
Independent fixed FP64 error bound on real trained Mistral operands
No contraction, reduction or precision-policy change
No profile with maximum threads exceeding actual device capability
timing_if_correct: Serial fresh operator processes, paired order counterbalanced, all samples retained, pressure and warm cohorts distinguished. No whole-model inference until operator gain is reproducible.
scope_limits: This is an untested proposal, not an optimization result.
Saved B1 speculative feasibility is not the B4 HTTP benchmark.
Single-token ordinary kernel tuning alone has not established the 2x goal.
